cn.t: Mixed reception for Michael Mayer's lavish production, with critics divided on its opulent aesthetic. Sopranos Lisette Oropesa, Ermonela Jaho, and Rosa Feola earn praise, though some find the staging overly garish and better suited to Act I than intimate scenes.
